how_to_apply: Visit the official SECI website: www.seci.co.in.
Go to the Careers section and locate Notification No. 03/2026 for Recruitment of Experienced Professionals.
Register with a valid e-mail ID and complete the online application form.
Upload a passport-size photograph and signature in the specified format (JPG/JPEG, 20 KB to 50 KB).
Upload category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD), if applicable, in the specified size (100 KB to 300 KB).

Upload educational mark sheets/certificates and post-qualification experience certificates (offer/appointment letter, experience certificate, last 3 months' pay slips, Form-16, joining/relieving order, etc.).
Pay the applicable application fee online, where applicable.
Review and submit the application before the closing date: 23.09.2026 (5 PM).
Applications sent through any mode other than the prescribed online mode will stand rejected. Incomplete applications, or those submitted with blurred/faded documents, will be summarily rejected.

important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. A candidate may apply for more than one position if eligible, but must submit a separate application for each post. Candidates employed in Government departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must forward their application through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the interview stage. Teaching experience will not be counted towards post-qualification experience. All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per Company rules. Selected candidates are liable to be posted at any Unit/Area/Project under SECI's control in different States or locations. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Delhi Court only. Candidates previously removed/terminated/who deserted employment from SECI will not be considered. Any further addendum/corrigendum/update will be published only on www.seci.co.in under the Careers section.

content_sections.heading: SECI Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: SECI is a Schedule 'A' Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, Government of India, and has been named one of the Renewable Energy Implementing Agencies (REIAs) of India. Through Notification No. 03/2026, titled "Recruitment of Experienced Professionals," SECI is hiring for 8 regular executive positions and 9 fixed-term executive positions. Register for Job Alerts

content_sections.heading: SECI Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify separate dates for admit card release, exam/interview date, or result declaration; these will be announced later on the SECI website's Careers section.

content_sections.heading: SECI Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: These posts carry an initial engagement of 3 years, extendable up to 2 additional years based on project requirement and performance, with posting anywhere in India. PwBD candidates are encouraged to apply on all the above posts; preference will be given based on suitability, as stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: SECI Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Besides Basic Pay, regular position holders are entitled to Dearness Allowance, HRA/Lease Allowance, Provident Fund, Medical benefits, Gratuity, New Pension Scheme, post-retirement medical facilities, House Building Advance, Child Education Loan, Conveyance Advance, Multipurpose Advance, Leave Encashment, Insurance, Mobile & Laptop, and other benefits as per Company rules. Basic Pay protection is available for PSU and Government employees as per DPE guidelines. Fixed term position holders additionally get market-aligned fixed pay, HRA/Bachelor's accommodation depending on place of posting, Mediclaim, Conveyance, Mobile & call charges, Leave Encashment, and TA/DA as per internal Company policy.

content_sections.heading: SECI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances, even if the candidature is later rejected. Candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before paying the fee.

content_sections.heading: SECI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: SECI reserves the right to revise the eligibility criteria upward, or limit the number of applications called for a post, based on marks obtained in Graduation/Post-Graduation/Diploma or years of relevant experience. Depending on the number of applications received, SECI may conduct a screening test, written test, trade test, or skill test, as deemed fit. Only shortlisted candidates found eligible based on the notified specifications will be called for a Written Test/Group Discussion/Interview. Mere possession of the minimum prescribed qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the next stage. The selection process stages will be updated on the SECI website's Careers section, and candidates are advised to check it periodically.

faq.question: Q1. What is SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SECI Recruitment 2026 refers to Notification No. 03/2026 issued by Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited for the recruitment of experienced professionals across 8 regular and 9 fixed-term executive posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 28 total vacancies - 9 under regular positions and 19 under fixed-term executive positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 23.09.2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from a B.Tech/B.E. in a relevant engineering discipline, LLB, CA/CMA, or MBA, to specific postgraduate qualifications. Post-wise details are listed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit ranges from 28 years to 55 years depending on the post, with relaxation applicable for reserved categories and PwBD candidates as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,000/- for regular executive positions and ₹500/- for fixed-term executive positions. SC/ST, Ex-servicemen, and PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SECI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at www.seci.co.in. Applications submitted through any other mode will stand rejected.
